I've struggled with problem spots for awhile, and finding an effective treatment hasn't been easy. That being said, Truly Targeted Acne-Clearing Pimple Patch with Salicylic Acid has made all the difference in my skin. This is an incredibly easy to use spot treatment, a liquid pimple patch. Just dab a thin layer on your problem areas and let it work its magic! Perfect for layering or on its own. An inclusion of 2% Salicylic Acid, 4% Niacinamide, and 0.2% Licorice Root all work together to deliver clear and calm skin. The addition of Salicylic Acid makes sense as it is known for its ability to unclog pores and reduce inflammation.
